cases.title: A complete attempt passes and is recorded

rubric.reason: Every layer, property and time the mentor mentions matches the tool output, including Title's four pairs ("0.5 s to 1.5 s, then 1.5 s to 3 s"), Subtitle's Opacity with `linear_end: end`, the Turn 3 reference to Bar's X Position and Trim Paths End, and "11 keyframe pairs" across "6 layers", which matches `counts` (10 linear + 1 partly_eased) and the six layers in `findings`.

`result: passed` and `demo_used: true` match the tool results, but the `record_lesson` summary says "Basic Easy Ease on transform properties is in place", which names a specific method when the check reports only `eased_by_learner` and the learner said only "done".
